brief: Prioritise this ageing unit for pre-event attention before the forecast heat event, as units of advanced age and high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in [MG-021] in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Ensure every de-rating applied is recorded along with the reason, the value, and the period ([MG-021]).
